attachment.add.scope: Authorization is by Jira project. Use the issue key, not a policy resource ID; an issue locator does not introduce a separate issue grant.
attachment.add.workflow: Upload attachments to the named issue through the action's multipart plan. Then use separately authorized attachment.list or verify to inspect returned attachment IDs. Attachments have separate add, list and download actions; attachment delete is not exposed. Local file descriptors generate metadata according to the transport's upload contract.

attachment.download.scope: Authorization is by Jira project. Use the issue key, not a policy resource ID; an issue locator does not introduce a separate issue grant.
attachment.download.workflow: Use the issue key and an attachmentId returned by attachment.list. Download returns bounded raw bytes under its own action authority; it does not advertise embedded or whole-result Markdown. Attachment delete is not exposed.

attachment.list.scope: Authorization is by Jira project. Use the issue key or accepted browser URL, not a policy resource ID; an issue locator does not introduce a separate issue grant.
attachment.list.workflow: List issue attachment metadata, then pass a returned numeric attachmentId to attachment.download or expectAttachmentId to verify. Listing is body-free and independently authorized from upload and download; attachment delete is not exposed.
attachment.list.resultPresentation: When advertised, whole-result Markdown preserves returned identifiers/timestamps as code spans and safe URLs as autolinks, neutralizes metadata controls/newlines and uses only the existing result. Selecting a format does not fetch bodies or add requests.

comment.add.scope: Authorization is by Jira project. Use the issue key or accepted browser URL, not a policy resource ID; an issue locator does not introduce a separate issue grant.
comment.add.readPresentation: When advertised, non-native readContentFormat adds a Markdown/text renderedBody to the owning comment while preserving its native ADF. It formats the returned body without an additional provider fetch; write contentFormat remains a separate control.
comment.add.content: Supply content with explicit contentFormat for the comment body. Both fields are required. When advertised, adf is a JSON document object; markdown and plain_text are strings converted to ADF. Format is never inferred; read this action's contentFormat enum. This comment action is absent when its native ADF target is disabled. Do not append your own attribution footer; configured attribution is applied in native ADF when content is written. Oversize content returns body_size_denied/413 and an unsupported format returns body_format_unsupported/415; source and converted content are omitted from audit and diagnostics.
comment.add.commentKind: Creates a top-level issue comment. Use jira.comment.reply with parentCommentId for a reply.

comment.list.selection: Use metadata-only listing followed by jira.comment.view for selected comment IDs in any order. Returned IDs, parentCommentId, author summaries, timestamps and visibility remain available without bodies. Selecting a format never enables includeBodies or adds fetches.
comment.list.resultPresentation: When advertised, whole-result Markdown preserves returned identifiers/timestamps as code spans and safe URLs as autolinks, neutralizes metadata controls/newlines and uses only the existing result. Selecting a format does not fetch bodies or add requests.

comment.view.selection: Read one selected commentId from jira.comment.list with the issue locator. The comment body is full, validated and bounded ADF. parentCommentId identifies a reply's parent, which may have appeared on another page. This action is independently authorized and can be used for selected IDs in any order.
comment.view.readPresentation: When advertised, non-native readContentFormat adds a Markdown/text renderedBody to the owning comment while preserving its native ADF. It formats the returned body without an additional provider fetch; write contentFormat remains a separate control.

issue.child.create.content: Supply content with explicit contentFormat for the description. The pair is optional; omit both for no description. When advertised, adf is a JSON document object; markdown and plain_text are strings converted to ADF. Format is never inferred; read this action's contentFormat enum. Do not append your own attribution footer; configured attribution is applied in native ADF when content is written. Oversize content returns body_size_denied/413 and an unsupported format returns body_format_unsupported/415; source and converted content are omitted from audit and diagnostics.
issue.child.create.workflow: Create a new issue already attached to the parent named by exactly one of parentIssue or parentUrl. Discover issueTypeId with issue_type.list and pass the returned string ID unchanged. Both the target project and resolved parent project must be authorized. Jira's hierarchy and issue-type rules still apply; arbitrary custom fields are unsupported. This is independently authorized from issue.create and has no rollback with earlier or later workflow calls. Use issue.parent.set to attach an existing issue instead.

issue.create.scope: Authorization is by Jira project. Use the Jira project key, not a policy resource ID; an issue locator does not introduce a separate issue grant.
issue.create.readPresentation: When advertised, non-native readContentFormat adds a Markdown/text renderedBody to the owning issue while preserving its native ADF. It formats the returned body without an additional provider fetch; write contentFormat remains a separate control.
issue.create.content: Supply content with explicit contentFormat for the description. The pair is optional; omit both for no description. When advertised, adf is a JSON document object; markdown and plain_text are strings converted to ADF. Format is never inferred; read this action's contentFormat enum. Do not append your own attribution footer; configured attribution is applied in native ADF when content is written. Oversize content returns body_size_denied/413 and an unsupported format returns body_format_unsupported/415; source and converted content are omitted from audit and diagnostics.
issue.create.workflow: Discover issueTypeId with jira.issue_type.list using the intended credential context and pass its decimal-string ID unchanged. Only project, issueTypeId, summary and the optional content pair are writable; arbitrary custom fields are unsupported. Creating an Epic, creating children and adding dependencies are separate authorized mutations without a multi-call rollback. Use issue.child.create for a new child or issue.parent.set for an existing issue.

issue.dependency.add.workflow: blockingIssue/blockingUrl names the issue that blocks blockedIssue/blockedUrl. Give exactly one locator per side; the issues must differ and both projects must be authorized. The configured dependency link is verified in that direction by readback. This call is independently authorized and does not roll back earlier Epic/child/parent mutations.

issue.parent.set.workflow: Assign an existing issue to exactly one parentIssue or parentUrl; select the child with issue or url. The child and parent must be distinct, and both resolved projects must be authorized. Jira decides hierarchy/issue-type compatibility. The action is independently authorized and verifies the parent by readback; it does not roll back other Epic workflow calls or accept arbitrary custom fields.

issue.update.scope: Authorization is by Jira project. Use the issue key or accepted browser URL, not a policy resource ID; an issue locator does not introduce a separate issue grant.
issue.update.readPresentation: When advertised, non-native readContentFormat adds a Markdown/text renderedBody to the owning issue while preserving its native ADF. It formats the returned body without an additional provider fetch; write contentFormat remains a separate control.
issue.update.content: Supply content with explicit contentFormat for the description. The pair is optional when summary is supplied; give at least summary or a complete content pair. When advertised, adf is a JSON document object; markdown and plain_text are strings converted to ADF. Format is never inferred; read this action's contentFormat enum. Do not append your own attribution footer; configured attribution is applied in native ADF when content is written. Oversize content returns body_size_denied/413 and an unsupported format returns body_format_unsupported/415; source and converted content are omitted from audit and diagnostics.
issue.update.update: Updates only summary and description. Give at least summary or a complete content/contentFormat pair; omitted content leaves the description unchanged. notifyUsers is optional: omission leaves Jira's default, while true/false are sent explicitly. Jira may require additional upstream permission to suppress notifications. Returned changedFields is ordered summary then description.

issue.view.scope: Authorization is by Jira project. Use the issue key or accepted browser URL, not a policy resource ID; an issue locator does not introduce a separate issue grant.
issue.view.presentation: Whole-result Markdown omits null standard context and shows None. for empty collections. Named values keep their IDs even when names are unavailable. Custom fields use readable names and IDs with explicit unsupported/withheld markers; custom-field nulls and empty arrays display as not set. An empty customFields array means no custom fields were returned, not that the project defines none. A returned null parent displays No parent returned. Embedded formatting retains native ADF and adds renderedBody beside the owning issue, comment or supported ADF custom-field value.
issue.view.discussionPaging: With includeComments=true, continue commentPage.nextStartAt through jira.comment.list with includeBodies=true. Keep chosen list size/order settings. isLast=true establishes completion of the visible page stream; null means unknown. Pages are independently authorized and are not a snapshot; a reply's parentCommentId may refer to another page. A byte-limited page contains fewer whole comments, never shortened bodies. Omitting includeComments or setting it false needs no comment companions, and selecting a presentation format alone never fetches comments.
issue.view.resultMetadata: Issue metadata includes timestamps, small user summaries, priority and labels when Jira returns them. Detailed context, custom fields and eligible embedded references are exclusive to issue.view and are absent from search and mutation readbacks.

project.list.request: Omitting maxResults uses the configured maximum advertised by this action (50 in the default configuration, at most 100). Results contain items, count, maxResults and scanStatus; count is not an upstream total.
project.list.resultPresentation: When advertised, whole-result Markdown preserves returned identifiers/timestamps as code spans and safe URLs as autolinks, neutralizes metadata controls/newlines and uses only the existing result. Selecting a format does not fetch bodies or add requests.

project.view.searchWorkflow: Use each returned jqlReference in a separately authorized search, for example cf[12345]. Do not substitute a display name or customfield_12345. Custom-field functions and sorting are unsupported; discovery does not establish creation requirements or field options.
project.view.resultPresentation: When advertised, whole-result Markdown preserves returned identifiers/timestamps as code spans and safe URLs as autolinks, neutralizes metadata controls/newlines and uses only the existing result. Selecting a format does not fetch bodies or add requests.

search.resultMetadata: Search results contain issue timestamps, small user summaries, priority and labels when supplied. They omit description bodies, detailed issue context, customFields, parent, subtasks and issueLinks. Whole-result formatting does not fetch those fields; use a separately authorized issue.view when needed.
search.fieldDiscovery: Use jira.project.view to discover a project's searchable fields and supported operators. Insert the returned jqlReference such as cf[12345]; do not use the display name or customfield_12345. Text ~ performs text matching rather than whole-value equality. Jira still validates field types.
search.resultPresentation: When advertised, whole-result Markdown preserves returned identifiers/timestamps as code spans and safe URLs as autolinks, neutralizes metadata controls/newlines and uses only the existing result. Selecting a format does not fetch bodies or add requests.

Read verification.status to distinguish matched from mismatch; verification has its own project authorization and is available as whole-result Markdown when advertised.
